title: Woodpatch /estimate request, version 1
description: ADR-0044. A SUBSET of parseRequest() in @woodpatch/gcode-server, which is authoritative: this schema cannot express the 25,000,000-byte body cap, the G-code's 20,000,000-byte and 2,000,000-line caps, a repeated key, or the machine record's own rules (machine-record-v1.schema.json, applied to the string's JSON text). toolId and materialId are reserved: refused until a later version adds them.

scope.description: An opaque token chosen by the caller (e.g. one per customer or staff account). Never parsed, never logged raw.

machine.description: The machine record's JSON text (ADR-0041's wire form), not a nested object.
